RRB NTPC vs RRB Group D: exam pattern compared

Both have 100 questions in 90 minutes, marked +1 / −⅓. RRB NTPC has General Awareness 40, Mathematics 30, General Intelligence and Reasoning 30; RRB Group D has General Science 25, Mathematics 25, General Intelligence and Reasoning 30, General Awareness and Current Affairs 20.

Questions people ask

What is the difference between the RRB NTPC and RRB Group D exam patterns?

Both have 100 questions in 90 minutes, marked +1 / −⅓. RRB NTPC has General Awareness 40, Mathematics 30, General Intelligence and Reasoning 30; RRB Group D has General Science 25, Mathematics 25, General Intelligence and Reasoning 30, General Awareness and Current Affairs 20.

Which has stricter negative marking, RRB NTPC or RRB Group D?

Neither: both take away a third of a right answer’s marks for each wrong answer (both +1 / −⅓).

Can I practise for both RRB NTPC and RRB Group D on Takkar?

Yes. Pick either exam in the app and every duel follows its marking and timing; you can switch exams any time. The quant and reasoning topics overlap a lot, so practice for one helps the other.
